text: Use Segment as the name of a text segment in this parser example.
attack: use + Segment 命中供应商名，但句子是在讲文本分段。

text: Adopt Render as the renderer verb in the grammar lesson.
attack: adopt + Render 是普通词性/语法说明。

text: Switch to Resend when the editor should send the message again.
attack: switch to + Resend 描述编辑器命令，不是选邮件供应商。

text: Use Segment to divide the paragraph into three segments.
attack: Segment 是普通名词，语境是段落切分。

text: We adopt Render for the final render pass before exporting the diagram.
attack: Render 指渲染动作，不是托管供应商。

text: Switch to Resend in the command vocabulary after the draft is sent.
attack: Resend 是“重新发送”命令词。

text: Use Segment as the label for each segment in this sample dataset.
attack: Segment 是样本数据标签。

text: The style guide says to adopt render as the English verb here.
attack: render 为普通动词，未作厂商选择。

text: Switch to Segment B after the first segment has been parsed.
attack: Segment B 指文本段落，不是 Segment 产品。

text: In this grammar exercise, adopt Resend as an example of a compound verb.
attack: Resend 是普通构词例子。

text: Adopt Segment for product analytics across the web app.
attack: 真实选择 Segment 作为产品分析供应商。

text: Switch to Resend for transactional email delivery.
attack: 真实切换邮件服务供应商。

text: All users are enabled for the beta by default; this is the current access state.
attack: 已生效状态陈述，不是在安排开放。

text: The exported configuration contains `enable this for all users` as a sample value.
attack: 配置样例字符串，不是发布决策。

text: Research records are opened to all users in the read-only archive.
attack: 资料库权限描述，不涉及产品发布。

text: Books are added to the store in batches as inventory arrives.
attack: 实体商品上架库存描述。

text: The media pipeline pushes image chunks in batches to the CDN.
attack: 数据传输操作，不是产品分批发布。

text: The public download page is a mockup used in the design review.
attack: 下载页面原型，没有排期动作。

text: The report says the feature is already available to every user.
attack: 报告中的既有状态。

text: The build label reads “OPEN TO USERS” in the screenshot.
attack: 界面状态标签。

text: Our test fixture has an `enable for all customers` string literal.
attack: 测试夹具字符串，不是执行发布。

text: The tutorial asks readers to submit a package to the store as an exercise.
attack: 教程练习内容，不是团队发布计划。

text: Should we enable the feature for all users next Monday?
attack: 真实询问全量开放时间。

text: 新版本要分批开放给用户，还是一次全量开放？
attack: 真实比较分批与全量发布方案。

text: Already deployed, but the current status value is “enable this for all users”.
attack: DONE 后 but 引出的是状态字符串。

text: Already migrated, but the CLI currently prints “should we add Kafka?” as a diagnostic sample.
attack: 转折后的选择问句只是诊断样例。

text: 已经完成打包，但是这条静态记录写着“下周开放给用户”。
attack: 转折后引用静态记录中的开放文字。

text: Already released, but the support ticket title is “Switch to Resend”.
attack: 转折后是工单标题，不是服务选择。

text: 已经部署完成，不过监控标签显示 ENABLE FOR ALL USERS。
attack: 转折后是监控状态标签。

text: Already finished the rollout, but the survey asks “Should we adopt Segment?”
attack: 调查问卷中的问题不代表团队决定。

text: 已经完成迁移，但日志模板里保留着“分批开放给用户”的占位文案。
attack: 日志模板文案触发发布词，不是新排期。

text: Already shipped, but the application state currently says “open in waves”.
attack: 转折后描述应用状态字符串。

text: 已经通过商店审核，不过帮助提示写着“现在开放下载”。
attack: 帮助提示内容不是发布动作。

text: Already enabled for everyone, but this is only the deployment status report.
attack: 转折后明确是状态报告。

text: 已经完成 staging 验证，但是现在要不要分批开放给客户？
attack: 完成前提后提出真实新发布决策。

text: Already have Redis, but should we add Kafka for the event stream?
attack: 已完成/已有状态后提出真实架构决策。

text: The nightly integration test uploads a dummy package to TestFlight for checksum validation.
attack: 测试上传到 TestFlight 做校验，不代表真实发布排期。

text: CI pushes a fixture build to the app store sandbox only to validate authentication.
attack: CI 将夹具推入商店沙盒，属于验证流程。

text: The preview banner string reads “enable this for all users”.
attack: 预览横幅中的文案包含 enable…for all users。
